content.hero_description: Traditional African art is not a relic of the past: it is a remarkably modern visual and algorithmic language. Our mission is to extract its geometry and bring it into the web of tomorrow.
content.pillars_disclaimer: The visuals above are code-generated geometric stylizations inspired by Ndop, Adinkra, Toghu, Kente, Bogolan, and Ndebele painting. They do not reproduce original patterns, each of which has a specific name and meaning.
content.lab_description: Change the pattern, hue, and scale: the result is rendered in real time without an image.
content.principle: Principle: name the origin, cite sources, and never reduce a symbol to mere decoration.
content.cta_description: We create bespoke visual identities and digital interfaces that resonate with elegance and authenticity.

ndop.title: Royal Ndop cloth
ndop.symbolism: Indigo resist-dyed cloth associated with traditional kingdoms; its networks of diamonds and lines express authority and unity.
ndop.implementation: Repeated diamond grids in SVG, computed in code and recolorable.

adinkra.title: Adinkra symbols
adinkra.symbolism: Stamped grid symbols, each carrying a proverb: Adinkrahene (leadership), Dwennimmen (humility and strength), Sankofa (learning from the past), and Nkyinkyim (adaptability).
adinkra.implementation: Cell-based vector icon grids, ready for semantic micro-interactions.

toghu.title: Toghu embroidery
toghu.symbolism: Prestigious ceremonial attire featuring embroidered bands of diamonds, triangles, and zigzags on a dark background.
toghu.implementation: Embroidery bands recreated in SVG with high-contrast HSL palettes.

kente.title: Kente weaving
kente.symbolism: Cloth woven from joined strips; its colors and patterns express rank, a proverb, or a story.
kente.implementation: SVG-generated vertical bands and checkerboards with configurable colors.

bogolan.title: Bogolan mud cloth
bogolan.symbolism: Cotton dyed with fermented mud and plants; its lines, crosses, and chevrons carry stories and protection.
bogolan.implementation: SVG lines, crosses, and chevrons for restrained, high-contrast backgrounds.

ndebele.title: Ndebele mural painting
ndebele.symbolism: House façades painted by women, with bold black outlines and vivid colors expressing identity and pride.
ndebele.implementation: Solid fills and bold outlines create highly legible interface components.

observe.title: Observe
observe.text: Study a pattern, its origin, use, and story through reliable, cited sources.

abstract.title: Abstract
abstract.text: Identify its geometric rules: repetition, rotation, symmetry, and color rhythm.

implement.title: Implement
implement.text: Translate those rules into SVG, CSS, or Canvas with HSL palettes and an accessible interface.
